# Dr. Ellen Vasquez — VP Quality & Patient Safety

- **Relationship:** cross-org — leads Quality, Patient Safety, and accreditation; no reporting
  line to Diane, but co-accountable for regulatory outcomes.
- **Cadence:** weekly during survey follow-up; owns the RCA/sentinel-event process.
- **What she cares about:** patient-safety metrics, CMS quality scores, and a clean Joint
  Commission record.

## How to work with her
- **Owns [Joint Commission Survey Readiness](../projects/jc-survey-readiness.md)** and is
  drafting the **Plan of Correction** for the June findings (Diane co-signs).
- Owns readmissions and HAC reduction on the quality side.

## Note
- Not to be confused with **Angela Vasquez** in Patient Financial Services — no relation; Ellen
  is the Quality VP.
